description: Exceptions of tools/check_action_reads.py, each with its reason. not_a_read: a literal "<key>" in a file of implemented_in that is not a read of the setting (a JSON field, a request parameter, a producer name ...); it never counts as found, for any action (optional `actions` narrows it), and `count` pins it to the number of literals "<key>" the file has now, so a new literal of that key in that file fails until someone looks at it. read_elsewhere: a declared read the files cannot show. flows: a settings field and a flow that disagree on purpose. An entry nothing needs any more fails the check.
